title: Menu
description: The overflow menu of a row or card: a ⋯ trigger (or your own) with items, icons, separators and a danger item last.
when: Secondary actions of a row or card (Đổi tên, Nhân bản, Xoá).
a11y: role="menu": Enter / Space / ↓ open, arrows move, Escape closes and returns focus to the trigger.
